goal: Analyze how livechat can connect to the alarm section of Chronos.

nodes.label: Analyze livechat integration into alarms
nodes.result_summary: User asked to explore the current project and produce a technical analysis for connecting livechat to the alarm section.

nodes.label: Inspect repo shape
nodes.result_summary: Found Expo/React Native mobile app, FastAPI server, LiveKit token service, LiveKit Python agent, AlarmKit wrapper, and Stitch alarm design artifacts.

nodes.label: Trace alarm code
nodes.result_summary: Alarm screen renders static local data; AlarmKit wrapper exists but native bridge implementation and UI calls are missing.

nodes.label: Trace LiveKit code
nodes.result_summary: Mobile can request a token, server can sign it, and agent can join a room, but no room/chat UI is rendered yet.

nodes.label: Trace calendar and persistence model
nodes.result_summary: Calendar events are mapped from timeline_items; there is no alarm table or alarm API.

nodes.label: Introduce dedicated alarm domain
nodes.result_summary: Alarms should not be stored as timeline_items because they have separate lifecycle, enabled state, native ids, smart rules, and sync state.

nodes.label: Split source of truth and execution
nodes.result_summary: Server should own alarm intent; mobile should execute native AlarmKit scheduling and report native ids or failures.

nodes.label: Add alarm REST API
nodes.result_summary: Add GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/alarms and optional preview endpoint for smart suggestions.

nodes.label: Add LiveKit agent tools
nodes.result_summary: Expose typed tools such as list_upcoming_events, create_alarm, update_alarm, and cancel_alarm.

nodes.label: Add mobile LiveKit and alarm sync
nodes.result_summary: Replace static alarm rows with fetched records, add LiveKit room UI, schedule/cancel through AlarmKit, and PATCH native scheduling state.

nodes.label: Identify risks
nodes.result_summary: Main risks are iOS-only AlarmKit behavior, permissions, timezone correctness, agent confirmation, and native/server sync failure.

nodes.label: Technical analysis complete
nodes.result_summary: Livechat integration is feasible, but should be layered through alarm persistence and agent tools before native scheduling.
